findings.claim: The new generator filters out any class carrying [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] from hand-written formatter registration by comparing AttributeClass.ToDisplayString() to a name built from AttributeNamespace. This is only existing-user-visible if a user already has their own type with that name. It also relies on AttributeNamespace being the right namespace constant for this attribute, and the diff does not show that it is.

receipt_plan.detail: Rerun the generator snapshot tests with an existing hand-written formatter class and confirm the resolver output is unchanged. Also confirm AttributeNamespace equals 'MessagePack'.

findings.claim: The generator reports diagnostics for formatters rejected by the collector, but the analyzer (MsgPack00x) never reports them. It only declares the descriptors. A formatter with a missing parameterless constructor or a mixed-key surrogate would show up as a generator diagnostic only when the generator runs. Existing projects are unaffected, so the impact is limited to the new feature.
